headline: Clinton order changes the rules for a federal advisory commission on health care consumer protection and quality.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13017, which set up the Advisory Commission on Consumer Protection and Quality in the Health Care Industry. That commission was created to give the President advice on protecting health care consumers and improving the quality of care. The title does not say which parts of the earlier order were changed, such as membership, duties, or deadlines.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Commission on Consumer Protection and Quality in the Health Care Industry
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules that govern how their commission is set up or run.
